Based on Cardmarket trend prices, the complete set is worth €1,488.01, with Charizard ex (201, Special illustration rare) as the most valuable card at €372.30, followed by Mew ex at €174.57, Blastoise ex at €109.14, Zapdos ex at €103.06 and Venusaur ex at €94.32.
